notes_summary: Enterprise media/archive search. Long documents (avg 6-12k tokens). Wants embeddings + reranker pipeline. Strong EU residency + audit/KMS needs. Evaluating Dedicated/Private with Redwood. POC scoped.
notes: Background: Sparrow Folio manages broadcast transcripts + long-form metadata for 18 regional networks. Search UX must return passages not just docs.
Scale: ~25M content items planned; average raw doc size 6k-12k tokens after OCR/cleanup. ~3B tokens total indexed.| Want vector index sharded by show/year.
Primary goal: move from keyword/opensearch -> RAG with embeddings and reranker for precision on long queries (multi-turn editorial workflows).
Latency/throughput targets: p95 end-to-end search <500ms for editorial UI, peak 150-200 QPS for internal users. Cost sensitive but UX first.

Chunking discussion: customer favors semantic chunking (sentence-boundary + topic segmentation) over naive fixed windows. Proposed chunk size 768-1024 tokens with 128-256 token overlap for continuity.
Indexing notes: plan to store chunk metadata (show, timestamp, segment) + original doc pointer. Want fast doc-level collapse after passage rerank.
ANN strategy: trial HNSW on FAISS for on-prem; consider IVF+OPQ for Dedicated to reduce memory. Need benchmark on 25M vectors (dim 1536).

Reranker tradeoffs: cross-encoder (re-rank top 50) gives best precision but heavy token cost. Options discussed: DistilRoBERTa cross-encoder for low-latency, vs miniLM mono-affinity model as cheap filter. Hybrid approach: mono-recall then cross-encoder top-K.

Cost model (rough): embedding per chunk $0.0004 => indexing cost large; per-query embedding (query vector) trivial. ANN lookup negligible. Cross-encoder (~512 token input) GPU cost estimate $0.02-$0.06 per rerank call depending on model & batch; target avg cost/query $0.01-$0.12 depending on rerank depth.

Latency mitigation: pin reranker to Dedicated GPU pool, batch small inference, quantize to int8 if possible. Use Redwood Optimize suggestions for batching/kv caching for common prefixes in editorial flows.
POC plan: 2-week run on 5M doc subset (representative: news + transcripts). Metrics: nDCG@10, MRR, recall@100, p50/p95 latency, cost per query. Deliver red/yellow/green thresholds.
Security: EU data residency mandatory for northern and central EU feeds. Need SSO/SAML, enterprise KMS, and 7-year audit logging/retention export for compliance.

Customer quotes: CTO - 'Cannot accept a solution that makes editors wait. If p95 slips, adoption dies.' Product lead - 'Must prove reranker improves precision on long queries, not just surface matches.'
Next-step engineering asks: sample embedding pipeline code, estimated sharded index RAM per 1M vectors (1536-dim), recommended reranker models & latency numbers on Dedicated g4dn-like nodes.

Internal concerns: SE wants clear fallback policy (smaller model when load high) and canary rollouts for reranker changes to avoid regressions. Redwood eval hooks + prompt/metric monitoring requested.
Procurement: legal requested draft DPA + SLAs; procurement timeline aligns with forecasted May decision if POC passes.
